$description: Values are taken from the Adobe XD design of the Gospel Ambition home page (artboard 'Web 1920 – 7', 1920px wide), read from the file's graphics tree, not from screenshots. Sizes are the design's pixel values at 1920px, converted to rem. Fluid sizes use cqi (1% of the width of the nearest container; base.css makes body one). The smaller ends of the clamp() sizes and the container gutter are proposals: there is no mobile design.

background.$description: Page background, tool cards, call-to-action cards, the nav bar.

text.$description: Body text and headings on light backgrounds. Same value as charcoal.

red.$description: The brand red. Primary buttons, the ribbon bands, the nav arch, highlighted words in headings, eyebrows, outline buttons, the ministries panel, the chat button.

red-dark.$description: A swatch saved in the design file but not used on the page. Used here only for hover on red buttons; the design has no hover states.

charcoal.$description: Text, the dark ministries section, and the overlay on the call-to-action photo (at 78%).

grey-wash.$description: Top of the wash gradient behind the stats and tools sections.

grey-light.$description: The swoosh crescents between sections, and the grey button.

grey.$description: 1px outlines of the light and grey buttons and the search field, and the search icon.

grey-dark.$description: 1px outline of the call-to-action cards. Barely visible on the dark photo behind them.

white.$description: Text on red, charcoal and photos; button labels on red.

wash.$description: Top-to-bottom wash behind the stats section and the tools section.

fade-hero.$description: Laid over the hero photo so it fades into the white page on its left.

fade-story.$description: Laid over the story photo so its left edge fades into white.

fade-top.$description: Laid over the top of a full-width photo band so it fades in from the white section above.

overlay.$value: linear-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, {color.charcoal} 78%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, {color.charcoal} 78%, transparent))
overlay.$description: Charcoal at 78%, over the photo behind the call-to-action section.

card.$description: Call-to-action cards. Tool cards have no shadow.

body.$description: Everything: headings, body, buttons, nav. The design uses Poppins Regular to ExtraBold, with italics.

heading.$description: Same family as body; headings differ by weight.

label.$description: Eyebrows above call-to-action titles only (Equip your ministry, PAY IT FORWARD, STAY CONNECTED). Caps-only, one weight.

regular.$description: Body text, intros, testimonial roles, the inactive tab.

medium.$description: Tool card category and description, the hero tagline, the copyright line.

semibold.$description: Buttons, nav links, subtitles on red ribbons, the active tab, testimonial names.

bold.$description: Section headings (h2), card titles (h3), the footer tagline.

heavy.$description: Page and ribbon titles (h1), the hero title (italic) and the 'Let's go.' display line.

display.$description: 'Let's go.' The design sets 80px type on a 66px line; 1 keeps the descenders clear.

small.$description: 18px. Nav links, outline buttons in cards, footer links and copyright. The nav Give pill is 17px in the design.

body.$description: 20px in the design. Body text, primary buttons, tool card descriptions.

subtitle.$description: 26px in the design. Subtitles on ribbons, tabs, the 'More tools' link, testimonial roles (25px in the design).

lead.$description: 32px in the design. Intros under section headings, the scripture block.

h3.$description: 36px in the design. Card titles, tool categories, statements, testimonial quotes. Testimonial names are 38px in the design, folded in here.

tagline.$description: 44px in the design. The footer tagline.

h1.$description: 66px in the design. The hero title and ribbon titles.

icon.$description: Width of the arrow icon in buttons (26px beside 20px text).

logo.$description: 93px. Height of the logo in the nav bar (320×93).

tool-logo.$description: 90px. Height of a tool logo in a tool card.

measure.$description: 836px. Width of the hero tagline and ribbon subtitles.

container.$description: 1640px. Width of every section's content (140px margins at 1920px).

md.$description: Call-to-action cards and their photos, the embedded chart.

lg.$description: Tool cards and the ministries panel.

pill.$description: Every button and the search field.

s.$description: 28px. Gap between tool cards, between the Give pill and the search field; button padding left and right.

m.$description: 48px. Card padding (43–50px in the design), the default flow gap.

l.$description: 64px. Space under the button in a tool card; between a heading block and a grid.

xxl.$description: 140px. The scripture block's indent (131px in the design).
